channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Meta Platform seeks to raise $95 billion through stock offering in largest ever funding round for AI expansion
item.description: Meta plans to raise up to $95 billion in its largest-ever equity fundraising to finance AI infrastructure, data centers and related opportunities. The company will seek $35 billion through public offerings and up to $60 billion through a later share-sale programme.

item.title: Microsoft to offer buyouts to 60,000 workers in latest cost cut
item.description: Microsoft Corp. will offer buyouts to about 60,000 workers, part of the company’s efforts to trim costs and retool its workforce for the artificial intelligence era.

item.title: Anthropic's Wall Street debut: How rich could its 7 co-founders get at a $1.5 trillion valuation?
item.description: Anthropic’s IPO filing offers a glimpse into the wealth and influence of its seven co-founders. As the AI firm prepares to go public, its shareholdings, voting power and philanthropic pledges are drawing attention, alongside the stakes held by tech giants Amazon and Google.

item.title: Microsoft buyout offer to employees: Who is eligible and what over 60,000 techies have been offered
item.description: Microsoft has offered voluntary exits to about 60,000 employees, or 27% of its global workforce. Eligible staff in four countries may receive severance, continued stock vesting, health insurance and career-planning support.&nbsp;

item.title: Why Hitachi Ventures wants a front-row seat in India’s deeptech boom
item.description: Hitachi Ventures is expanding its India deeptech bets across AI, energy and advanced manufacturing, but says high entry valuations and uncertain exits call for caution.

item.title: Lab Rats series: Cracking vaccines, biosecurity and personalized cancer with PopVax
item.description: Launched in 2021 in the thick of the covid pandemic, the Hyderabad-based startup has an ambitious pipeline of first-in-class vaccines and drugs that it hopes to accelerate to clinics in the next two years.

item.title: Three challenges facing HDFC Bank’s new CEO
item.description: HDFC Bank's new CEO Anup Bagchi faces the challenge of rebuilding confidence, preventing further senior management departures and reviving the growth engines.

item.title: Noel Tata disputes Tata Sons board minutes, says Chandrasekaran's reappointment should be deleted from official records.
item.description: The minutes misrepresented his objections and omitted mention of two key conditions agreed by board members, Noel Tata wrote. However, Tata Sons did not make the changes requested, and made a statutory filing about the reappointment.

item.title: Tata Motors completes Iveco acquisition to turbocharge global play
item.description: The $4.5 billion deal will expand the Indian automaker’s global footprint and strengthens its presence across commercial vehicle segments.

item.title: Microsoft to offer buyouts to 60,000 employees in India, US, UK and Canada as it restructures workforce for AI
item.description: Microsoft Corp. will offer buyouts to about 60,000 workers, part of the company’s efforts to trim costs and retool its workforce for the artificial intelligence era.

item.title: Noel Tata challenges Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman, seeks board meeting video
item.description: Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata has challenged N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman, calling the resolution void over procedural concerns. Noel has also sought an unedited board meeting video.

item.title: Tata Consumer’s Q2 profit rises 16%, in line with estimates
item.description: TCPL's consolidated revenue rises 14% to ₹5,661.13 crore.

item.title: Medanta chairman Naresh Trehan’s appointment to pharma marketing panel sparks conflict of interest debate
item.description: A advocacy group has questioned Medanta chairman Naresh Trehan's appointment to a government panel reviewing pharmaceutical marketing rules, citing potential conflicts of interest and past concerns over hospital medicine prices.&nbsp;

item.title: Is Indian space agency being privatised? ISRO chief V Narayanan clarifies role of private sector in space missions
item.description: V Narayanan stated that the space agency would significantly expand its operations, with four functional launch pads planned by 2029.

item.title: Arvind Limited in Varanasi: PM Modi inaugurates ₹150 crore plant with 1,000-job potential – Know about the company
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Arvind Limited’s new garment manufacturing unit in Varanasi. The facility is expected to boost Uttar Pradesh’s textile industry, create jobs with a predominantly women-led workforce, and connect local garment production with international markets.

item.title: Explainer: Why is the CCPA penalising restaurant chains over service charges?
item.description: The Central Consumer Protection Authority is penalising restaurants for automatically adding service charges to bills, ruling that defaulting to an opt-out system unfairly forces consumers to pay unless they actively demand removal.

item.title: Google CEO Sundar Pichai says company is giving up short-term cloud revenue to prioritise advanced AI development
item.description: Google CEO Sundar Pichai says the company is sacrificing short-term Cloud revenue to give DeepMind the computing power needed for advanced AI research. He also warned that limited capacity could make new customer requests for 2027 difficult to fulfil.

item.title: Tata Communications targets 40% of India's data centre connectivity market with ₹4,350 crore investment
item.description: The initial phase of the project will focus on the Mumbai-Pune-Hyderabad-Chennai corridor, which Tata Communications considers an important growth route for AI infrastructure and hyperscale data centres.

item.title: SC takes up EY’s tax dispute over overseas employee transfers
item.description: The case hinges on whether payments for overseas employee secondments are mere cost reimbursements or taxable fees for technical services.

item.title: Fund managers put more of their own money into funds to win LP trust
item.description: For established firms, capital generated from earlier funds can help finance fresh commitments.

item.title: Tata Communications bets $400-450 mn on India's data centre connectivity boom
item.description: Tata Communications plans to invest up to $450 million over three to five years in a 10,000-km fibre network linking India’s data centre hubs. The first phase will connect Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad and Chennai.

item.title: Unacademy's Gaurav Munjal, Roman Saini plan ₹700-crore fund focused on AI, deeptech startups: Report
item.description: According to a report, the fund, named Longshot Capital, has secured commitments of about ₹300 crore and is targeting its first close in January 2027, following which it plans to start investing.

item.title: Hyundai launches Bayon SUV, targets 250,000 mid-size sales in a year
item.description: Hyundai Motor India launched the Bayon, its first new car in three years, as it looks to strengthen its position in the mid-size SUV segment.

item.title: Why IIT Bombay is startup factory: These companies, entrepreneurs are already creating waves in biz world globally
item.description: While some IIT Bombay graduates have built successful companies from the ground up, others are backing ambitious founders and helping startups scale. Here, meet alumni who are leading startups and unicorns.

item.title: L Catterton makes strategic investment in InMobi-backed Glance
item.description: The investment reflects L Catterton’s conviction in Glance’s potential to help shape the future of shopping as artificial intelligence (AI) transforms how consumers discover and purchase products.

item.title: How AI is reshaping the workforce: New roles, more cross-functional teams; biggest risk is failing to plan, says report
item.description: AI is reshaping work across Asia Pacific, increasing the importance of offices as hubs for collaboration and knowledge exchange. However, many organisations have not adapted workplace and lease strategies to expected workforce changes, a Colliers report found.&nbsp;

item.title: Swiss watchmakers put faith and language on the dial to woo Indian buyers
item.description: Driven by a 28.5% surge in Swiss watch exports to India, luxury brands are moving beyond logo-led designs to craft bespoke, heritage-rich timepieces for local collectors.

item.title: Tata Chemicals shares latest update on TCML dispute in Kenya High Court matter — What the case is all about
item.description: Kenyan President William Ruto had earlier ordered the Indian firm to leave the century-old Magadi soda ash operation it has run for two decades.

item.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed $40 billion debt deal for AI chips as firm ‘investment grade, has Starlink, launch revenue’
item.description: SpaceX has closed a $40 billion debt deal to buy Nvidia GPUs for its AI data centers. Billionaire Elon Musk said the company's investment grade, Starlink and launch revenue will support the borrowing.

item.title: IIFL Capital hires four Barclays bankers to expand wealth business
item.description: The Fairfax-controlled firm is stepping up its push to attract wealthy Indian families as competition intensifies and global banks restructure their workforces.

item.title: JSW MG taps into Chinese parent Saic for 70% of its purchases
item.description: Nearly 70% of the joint venture’s purchases in the financial year 2026 came from Saic-linked firms, taking their total business with the Indian carmaker to about $840 million, including royalty and licence fee

item.title: Eternal’s District explores live-event venues to cut concert costs, counter AI threat
item.description: The out-of-home consumption platform is exploring partnerships with property owners and governments to build dedicated venues as it seeks to scale its events business and strengthen its defences against AI-led disruption.

item.title: Wow! Momo plans ₹300 crore fundraise, eyes overseas expansion ahead of proposed IPO
item.description: The Kolkata-based QSR chain plans to enter Sri Lanka this year and explore the UAE, while scaling its packaged-food business and targeting ₹1,050 crore in FY27 revenue.

item.title: Introducing Lab Rats: A Mint series on India’s biotech startups
item.description: India’s drug innovation story has so far been told through the lens of established pharmaceutical companies. But a new generation of biotech startups is attempting bolder feats with a fraction of the funding.

item.title: Katrina Kaif’s Kay Beauty hits ₹350 cr valuation, completing one year in UK's retail market with luxury chain Space NK
item.description: Katrina Kaif’s Kay Beauty has crossed ₹350 crore in gross merchandise value as it expands internationally through British luxury beauty retailer Space NK. The brand, launched with Nykaa in 2019, is growing its presence beyond India.
